observation_permissions.source_rows: whole episode/group split, never adjacent random split

exact_input_conflicts.scope: exact float32 restricted input only; no conflict is not sufficient observability evidence

trained_S_divergence.scope: time-matched distinct closed-loop trajectories are descriptive, not same-state causal interventions
trained_S_divergence.interpretation: Exact Teacher-state fit may be good while own executed history moves out of demonstrated states; nearest normalized RMS is descriptive, not a universal OOD gate. No proof of force information insufficiency.
